notes: Endpoint patterns describe families; | separates allowed methods and * matches routes.
A violation code is nested in violations; the envelope code is VALIDATION_FAILED or INTEGRATION_INCOMPLETE.
Job failures and capability availability are successful HTTP 200 representations, not HTTP errors.
Retry-After is a positive integer in seconds; AI queue delay is advisory.
All application error bodies carry requestId; successful job/capability representations carry X-Request-ID in the header.
